candidates.reason: Just a shrunken copy of the portrait layout in the middle of the banner with huge empty sides; the details, pills, CTA label and legal text are microscopic and can't be read; this is not a re-layout.

The two-column banner idea is sound and the headline leads, but the badge pills are pushed against the bottom edge; the legal text is tiny and sits right against the TASTINGS pill; the red 'missing asset' placeholder box is cut off at the right edge; the product can sits isolated at the far right; and the sun circle is cropped awkwardly behind the headline.

Same structure as candidate 2 with an even bigger headline, but the pills crowd the tagline and almost touch the bottom edge, the legal text is crammed against the TASTINGS pill, the broken 'missing asset' box remains, the can floats alone on the right, and the left column feels overstuffed while the right side has dead space.

The RSVP CTA is shrunk to the size of the badges, so the call to action is buried; the logo reads 'SOLST CE'; the italic tagline column competes with the headline; the 'Sunset Sessions' headline breaks into a heavy two-line block; the reserve text, legal text and broken asset box are scattered fragments; and the reading order is jumbled.
